signs.Aries: You may feel drawn to an older person today. Perhaps you have admired the dignity that growing older brings with it and feel you could benefit. Or perhaps the whole question of age has become a big issue in your life at the moment. Whatever the scenario, remember it is not the number of years, but whether one is still willing to learn that counts.
signs.Taurus: Today brings with it possible feelings of alienation from one's partner and loved one. It may be that a certain issue has been bubbling away beneath the surface and has now finally come to a head. Don't avoid discussing it, as this is an essential part of the process of moving beyond this wall and rediscovering the state of union. Be prepared to work at it.
signs.Gemini: You may be feeling a little rejected. Whether it was your fault or theirs is not really the issue. What does need to be acknowledged, through heart-to-heart discussion, is that both of you have contributed to the problem, and it will take both of you to solve it in such a way that you are truly happy with the results.
signs.Cancer: This is a day where the quest for romance could be a little hard going. Others seem keen enough to talk, and may offer a lot of information, but only up to a point. After this you can sense a barrier beyond which you will not be allowed to journey unless you pass some subtle test, devised by them, to stop certain people from ever hurting them again.
signs.Leo: It is just as well you maintain some distance between you and those in whom you are potentially interested today. The current planetary position may mean that you feel less than inclined to be bothered with the search for romance. Perhaps you would be better to take some time to be alone, and to determine what you do truly need from a relationship, and what in turn you can give.
signs.Virgo: The current planetary aspect indicates that you could have a vested interest in appearing more morose than you actually feel. Do you not tend to manipulate other's feeling through guilt? Do you sometimes withhold affection? Although this often works, today it may backfire, and you may find yourself in a much worse position for having played this game.
signs.Libra: You may have to do some serious and constructive talking today concerning your current relationship. You have reached a point where there is still a chance to talk through any difficulties and restore the passion and love that once existed between you so fervently. It all depends on what the next stage of the game is, and on both of you being absolutely honest.
signs.Scorpio: A flaw in your current relationship, which up until now has remained hidden, may be suddenly revealed today. The question is, what are you now going to do about it? You can choose to ignore it, hoping that if you keep that subject at bay it will eventually vanish, or you can begin to be responsible at least for your actions and start to do something positive.
signs.Sagittarius: You may choose today to cement a long standing, or perhaps not-so-long standing relationship. At least you may pop the question or imply that you would like to continue to deepen the bond between you. It may take some planning, but the celebration is ultimately the outer symbol of the wonderful and harmonious union you currently feel between you.
signs.Capricorn: You have an opportunity today to let someone know how you really feel about a situation. The problem is that you have been fearful to cross a line that seems to be set in stone, and which is actually causing you quite a bit of upset. You need to talk this through, no matter what the outcome, at least for your own peace of mind.
signs.Aquarius: You have a strong feeling that you seriously need to be by yourself for a while. This is probably a good idea. You have spent quite a lot of time listening to other people and their advice on your current relationship problem, but have not truly listened to yourself, to your own needs and wishes. Time spent in thinking deeply about this will bring answers.
signs.Pisces: The position of the planets indicates that relationships may be going through a sticky patch. On the one hand, your partner seems to want more freedom. On the other hand, they do not want to grant the same privileges to you. There may be a bit of a tussle concerning who allows whom to do what. But try not to end the day on a bad note.
